content: lipgloss uses a fluent builder pattern: lipgloss.NewStyle().Method().Method().Render(content). Border struct has Top/Bottom/Left/Right/corner fields; custom borders defined by setting struct literals. BorderStyle() sets preset or custom border; BorderLeft(true) enables left side only with BorderRight/Top/Bottom(false) for pure sidebar. BorderForeground() colors the border characters. Width() causes automatic word wrapping at specified columns. Custom left-bar style: NewStyle().BorderStyle(lipgloss.Border{Left:"▌"}).BorderLeft(true).BorderRight(false).BorderTop(false).BorderBottom(false).BorderForeground(lipgloss.Color("9")).PaddingLeft(1). Render returns a string; does not print.
